design.plan_section: docs/EXPERIMENT_PLAN.md, '2026-08-01 Phase 1B 基线协议分解 P1（released baseline 协议归因，用户批准）'
design.question: attribute the released-InfBaGel-minus-D2 contact gap to inference-time guidance, sampler iteration count and the autoregressive rollout rewrite, separately from any genuine model difference
manipulated_factors: executed git commit (c358fa4 vs HEAD rollout)
design.cells: 2 commits x 3 knob settings = 6 released-checkpoint inference runs
design.additional_probes: 2 HOIPrior native evaluations run to obtain absolute GT-contact-frame hand-object distance, which no aggregate reports
design.lifecycle_profile: user-authorized inference-only measurement (plan, 流程精简): no run id allocated and no tools/experiment.py start manifest; traceability is carried by the executed git commit, the archived Hydra resolved config and overrides, the fixed official 438-sequence test set and byte-identical metric code

executed_commits.plan_amendment_commit_note: the dated plan amendment, this compact result, the phase summary, the evidence-index rows and the registry completion row are one closure change; the executed source objects above predate it

reproduces_sealed_worker_evaluation.note: single-host re-evaluation of the same final-online checkpoint reproduces the retired two-host worker aggregate exactly

reproduction_gate.form: A0-old must reproduce the sealed published row
reproduction_gate.note: the plan records this gate as 16/16, i.e. the 16 non-ratio aggregate metrics; the stricter all-18 comparison, which additionally includes hand_pen_ratio and human_pen_ratio, is also exactly equal

determinism.form: each released-checkpoint cell re-run once with save_motion_params=true

independent_extraction.purpose: recompute per-sequence contact statistics from the exported prediction / ground-truth npz and motion_params, independently of the aggregates

feet_height_excluded.reason: the seventh pooled quantity, feet_height, agrees only to float32-vs-float64 accumulation (largest absolute difference 3.9e-09) and is therefore not counted as a bit-exact reproduction

recall_identity_from_distance_pipeline.form: per-sequence fraction of GT-contact frames below the 5 cm threshold, pooled as an unweighted 438-sequence mean, equals the published contact_recall

rollout_rewrite_null_on_contact_quality.note: predicted contact_percent is the one contact-family quantity the rewrite moves significantly; contact precision, recall and F1 are all null

guidance_improves_foot_sliding.direction: guided foot sliding is lower, i.e. better
guidance_improves_foot_sliding.explanation: code/priors/contact_guidance.py (D2-Q0) and code/priors/routed_guidance.py (D2-R0) reference apply_feet_floor_contact_guidance zero times; both implemented only the author hand-object x10 term and omitted the feet-floor x500 term

decision_rule.preregistered: g = (R_g - R_u) / (R_g - R_x) with R_g = A0-old contact recall, R_u = A-old contact recall, R_x = D2-X contact recall 0.59445

branches.g_ge_0.5: the gap is mainly inference-time guidance; past released-vs-D2 comparisons are unfair; enabling guidance for HOIPrior may be proposed later at equal budget but must report foot sliding, object translation MAE and pelvis goal
branches.g_le_0.2: guidance contributes little; adding guidance would be test-time optimization of the scored metric, so the lever is abandoned in favour of the stepwise object-occupancy requery measured by cell B
branches.0.2_lt_g_lt_0.5: insufficient on its own; must be re-argued with cell B and the rollout share

decision_rule.consequence: guidance for HOIPrior is not authorized by this sub-phase; it still requires a separate dated amendment and explicit user approval

gt_contact_distance.definition: per GT-contact frame, min over the two SMPL hand joints (22, 23) of the distance to the nearest vertex of the posed predicted object mesh; restricted to frames where either GT hand is within the 5 cm contact threshold, i.e. the mask at code/eval_metrics.py:271
gt_contact_distance.source_expression: the contact_dist / gt_contact_dist accumulator of code/eval_metrics.py:264-283, which compute_hand_object_interaction computes but never returns, so it has no published aggregate
gt_contact_distance.measurement_caveat: FROM a skeleton hand joint, not the hand mesh surface, and TO the nearest object mesh vertex, not the nearest surface point; both the prediction and the GT leg use the identical definition

ground_truth_reference.note: identical for all eight runs; it is the GT-vs-GT floor of the metric

interpretation.statement: HOIPrior's raw generative geometry is genuinely worse: protocol-matched, both unguided, D2-X sits 0.8334 cm further from the object with a paired 95% CI that excludes zero, so the 1.6587 cm guided advantage of the released model splits roughly half real prior quality and half inference-time guidance purchase
interpretation.d2ag_vs_d2x: +0.0351 cm with a CI that crosses zero: D2-AG is geometrically indistinguishable from D2-X despite its higher contact F1, so its F1 gain came from the operating point, not from putting hands nearer objects

failure_profile.question: are failed GT-contact frames near misses or gross misses
failure_profile.conditioning: fractions are conditional on a frame failing the 5 cm contact threshold
failure_profile.conclusion: the failure mode is gross misses, not near misses: 57.94% of D2-X's failed GT-contact frames are at >=8 cm against 16.93% in [5,6) cm
failure_profile.contradicts: this is evidence AGAINST the earlier 'the model knows when to make contact and misses by a few cm' framing in its literal form

recall_scoring_artifact.finding: 41 of the 438 official sequences contain no GT-contact frame; code/eval_metrics.py:316-320 scores contact_recall 0 when TP+FN == 0, and the aggregate is an unweighted mean over all 438 sequences
recall_scoring_artifact.affects: every contact_recall value in this project, absolute values and differences alike

errata.subject: registered contact-F1 minimum 0.6598838781 is a cross-protocol constant
errata.detail: it was defined as F1_X + 0.25 * (F1_released - F1_X) with the guided released row. The F1 gap 0.08983 decomposes into guidance 0.05883 (65.5%), iteration 0.00290 (3.2%) and genuine model difference 0.02810 (31.3%); the protocol-aligned 25% closure threshold is about 0.64445

errata.subject: protocol-aligned gap closure
errata.detail: recomputed against the unguided one-step released row, D2-AG reaches 0.451 (recorded 0.1409) and D2-AC 0.376 (recorded 0.1176), both above 0.25, while D2-AE 0.161 and D2-AF 0.129 still fail and D2-AD is negative under both conventions. No run's overall decision changes: D2-AG still fails on its paired F1 CI lower bound -0.0082 and its foot-sliding ratio CI upper bound 1.184. What changes is the recorded set of failure reasons

errata.subject: released_95_percent_effectiveness contains a protocol component
errata.detail: for D2-AG the contact-F1 ratio 0.894 fails against the guided released row but is 0.973 and passes against the protocol-matched unguided row; recall moves 0.823 -> 0.923 and foot sliding 1.203 -> 1.086, both still failing. '11 checks, 6 passed' is therefore not a pure model statement

errata.subject: experiments/results/p1_hoi_phase1b_d2aa_table5_completion_s42_20260724.json .local_protocol.native_quality is false for the released row it contains
errata.detail: that field declares sample_type diffusion, diffusion_steps 500, guidance false, cfg false, scene false, while the table includes the released row, which was produced with the consistency sampler at cm_timesteps 16, guidance_weight 1, CFG w 1 and scene/object-voxel conditioning. The file is hash-bound by three registry rows and four documents, so per existing precedent it is not edited in place; the fact is registered here

conclusion: The released InfBaGel row was never a protocol-matched comparison for the D2-* HOIPrior rows. Of the 0.13313 contact-recall difference between the released row and D2-X, inference-time guidance accounts for 59.20%, the 16-vs-1 iteration count for 6.37% and the genuine model difference for 34.43%; of the 0.08983 contact-F1 difference, guidance accounts for 65.49%, iteration for 3.23% and the model for 31.28%. Iteration count is a null effect on contact F1 under both rollouts and the rollout rewrite is a null effect on contact precision, recall and F1. Guidance also improves foot sliding, opposite to the D2-Q0 measurement, because the two local guidance implementations omitted the feet-floor term. HOIPrior is nevertheless genuinely geometrically worse: protocol-matched and both unguided, D2-X sits 0.8334 cm [0.4906, 1.1824] further from the object at GT-contact frames, so the released model's 1.6587 cm guided advantage is about half prior quality and half inference-time purchase. D2-AG is geometrically indistinguishable from D2-X (+0.0351 cm, CI crosses zero) despite a higher contact F1. The residual failure mode is gross misses, not near misses: 57.94% of D2-X's failed GT-contact frames are at >=8 cm against 16.93% in [5,6) cm.
next_action: Treat every released-minus-D2 gap, gap-closure fraction and released-95% ratio already recorded in this repository as a cross-protocol quantity that overstates the model deficit, and cite this compact result and docs/phase_summaries/PHASE_1B_PROTOCOL_DECOMP.md when reusing them. This sub-phase authorizes no training, no checkpoint selection, no change to the native D2 protocol and no production guidance or stepwise object requery for HOIPrior; each of those still needs a separate dated plan amendment and explicit user approval. Phase 1B HOIPrior search remains closed and the next session entry point is unchanged: a dated Phase 1C HSIPrior plan-only preregistration.
